post.summary: Send a sign-up code over WhatsApp
post.description: The same response whether or not the number has an account. Language follows `Accept-Language`.

400.description: INVALID_PHONE_NUMBER: not a mobile number in international format.

post.summary: Confirm a sign-up code

400.description: INVALID_CODE (with `attemptsLeft`) or CODE_EXPIRED: ask for a new code.

post.summary: Create the account and sign in
post.description: Needs a `verificationToken` from confirming a code. Language follows `Accept-Language`.

400.description: VERIFICATION_TOKEN_INVALID: verify the number again; or VALIDATION_FAILED.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: retry with the same verificationToken.

post.summary: Sign in with phone and password
post.description: With two-factor on, a right password returns 200 with a `challengeToken` and sends a code; finish with POST sessions/two-factor.

200.description: Password right; a two-factor code was sent

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS: the same for an unknown number and a wrong password.

post.summary: Finish a two-factor sign-in with the code
Send another two-factor code
post.description: Returns a new `challengeToken`: the previous one belonged to the previous code.

post.summary: Exchange the refresh token for a new pair
post.description: The refresh token rotates: store the new one. Send one refresh at a time; for 30 s the previous token is still answered with the same new pair, so a lost response can be retried.

200.description: A new access and refresh token

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: retry with the same refresh token.

delete.description: The access token keeps working until it expires (at most 10 minutes); the refresh token stops at once.

post.description: The same response whether or not the number has an account.

202.description: If the number has an account, a code was sent

post.summary: Set a new password with the reset code
post.description: Signs out every session; sign in again with the new password.

post.summary: Send a password reset code
post.description: The same response whether or not the number has an account. Venue owners get no code: they reset through Hagz support, and the app should say so on this screen. Warn members before they ask: a reset makes them read-only at every venue until a staff manager restores them.

202.description: If the number has an account, a code was sent

post.summary: Set a new password with the reset code
post.description: Signs out every session, and lowers every permission to at most `view` at each venue the member belongs to. The owner and members who manage staff are notified; the previous permissions are kept so they can be restored.

post.summary: Send a code to turn two-factor on or off
Check email and password
post.description: Always followed by a code from the authenticator app (set up first if `TOTP_SETUP`).

200.description: Password right; ask for a code

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS: the same for an unknown email and a wrong password.

post.summary: Get a new authenticator secret
post.description: Only for accounts without a confirmed authenticator. Asking again replaces the secret; the first code accepted from it confirms it.

200.description: Show the URI as a QR code

post.summary: Finish signing in with an authenticator code
post.description: Sets the session cookies. The session lasts 12 hours and isn't extended.

Set-Cookie.description: The access and refresh cookies (httpOnly; the web app never reads them).

401.description: CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: sign in again (each challenge works once).

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: retry with the same code if it's still current.

post.summary: Renew the access cookie
post.description: Uses the refresh cookie and rotates it. Send one refresh at a time. The session still ends 12 hours after sign-in.

Set-Cookie.description: The access and refresh cookies (httpOnly; the web app never reads them).

delete.description: Ends the session the refresh cookie belongs to and clears both cookies.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED: refresh, or sign in.

post.summary: Invite someone to become an admin
post.description: Emails a link that works for 48 hours and replaces any earlier invitation to the same email.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED: refresh, or sign in.

post.summary: Create an admin account from an invitation
post.description: The token is in the invitation link's fragment (`#token=`). Continue with sessions/totp-setup: the account can't sign in until its authenticator is set up.

201.description: Account created; set up the authenticator

get.summary: The venues I belong to, with my permissions at each

404.description: VENUE_NOT_FOUND: not a venue you belong to.

put.description: Needs `staff: manage`. Nobody can change their own permissions or the owner's, and only the owner can give more in an area than they have themselves.

403.description: PERMISSION_DENIED, CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_PERMISSIONS, CANNOT_CHANGE_OWNER, or PERMISSION_ABOVE_YOUR_OWN (with the `areas`).

post.summary: Give back what a password reset took away
post.description: Needs `staff: manage`. Works while the member is `restorable`; the same limits as setting permissions apply.

403.description: PERMISSION_DENIED, CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_PERMISSIONS, CANNOT_CHANGE_OWNER, or PERMISSION_ABOVE_YOUR_OWN (with the `areas`).

409.description: NOTHING_TO_RESTORE: their permissions changed since the reset.
